pages.title: Explosions & destruction  ·  Status effects  ·  Movement showcase

presets.name: Alert Pulse
presets.summary: A soft pulse of light around a HUD icon, for warnings and ready states.
useCases: Low health, low mana and low ammo warnings
Ability and cooldown ready pings
Notification badges and quest markers

presets.name: Arcane Sparkles
presets.summary: Drifting four-point sparkles in a rotating palette, for enchantments and treasure.
useCases: Enchanted items, potions, portals and shrines
Loot beams, checkpoints and healing auras
Set Emit from edge to make an aura ring instead of a filled area

presets.name: Arrow Impact - Wood
presets.summary: Long splinters driven out of a wooden surface by an arrow.
useCases: Arrows, bolts and thrown spears landing on wood
Ranged combat in a fantasy or medieval game
Pair with Arrow Trail so the shot and the hit agree

presets.name: Arrow Trail
presets.summary: A thin streak of disturbed air that follows an arrow in flight.
useCases: Arrows, bolts, spears and thrown weapons in flight
A fast projectile in a game with a clean, unmagical art style
Pair with a hit preset at the other end: this is the flight, that is the landing

presets.name: Artillery Impact
presets.summary: A huge dirt plume with a smoke column, for shelling and bombardments.
useCases: Off-screen artillery, mortar fire and bombardments
A boss attack that has to be seen coming from anywhere on screen
The impact at the end of a long shell arc

presets.name: Ash Fall
presets.summary: Grey ash flakes tumbling down, for the quiet after a fire.
useCases: Burnt forests, ruined towns and volcanic skies
The calm after an explosion or a boss fight
Any scene that should feel cold, dirty and still

presets.name: Autumn Leaves
presets.summary: Leaves tumbling and drifting down in a wide band, for autumn scenes.
useCases: Autumn, forest and graveyard levels
Wind gusts: raise Gravity to 200 with Gravity angle 120 to blow leaves across the screen
Indoor leaves: shrink the band, raise the rate for a swirl

presets.name: Barrel Explosion
presets.summary: Metal shrapnel thrown out of a bursting container.
useCases: Exploding barrels, crates, tanks and pipelines
Anything with a metal skin that should break into pieces
The shrapnel layer of a vehicle going up

presets.name: Big Explosion
presets.summary: The large blast: wide, slow and loud, for buildings and bosses.
useCases: Buildings, tankers, generators and boss attacks
The blast at the end of a set-piece
Anywhere the explosion is the event, not the feedback

presets.name: Bleeding
presets.summary: Drops of blood that fall from a wounded character and hit the ground.
useCases: Bleed and wound statuses
Low health states on characters and bosses
Retint to blue for slime, or to white for a leaking machine

presets.name: Blizzard
presets.summary: Driving snow across the screen, for storms and frozen levels.
useCases: A blizzard, a snowstorm or a frozen level's weather layer
Wind-driven snow on a mountain pass
Any scene where Snowfall is too gentle

presets.name: Blood Splatter
presets.summary: Drops of blood that spray out, arc down and settle, for hits and wounds.
useCases: Melee and bullet hits on characters
Wounds, killing blows and boss hits
Fire Emit particles from an event to spray blood at the exact hit point

presets.name: Blossom Pop
presets.summary: Pink flowers bursting outward in a ring.
useCases: A spring or garden level, or a nature spirit's attack
A gentle reward or a healing effect
A title screen or a menu where the effect should charm

presets.name: Bomb Crater
presets.summary: Dirt thrown up and out where a bomb hits the ground.
useCases: Bombs, mines and shells hitting soil
Artillery and bombing runs in a battlefield level
Pair with Big Explosion for the fire and Smoke Ring Blast for the cloud

presets.name: Bonfire Column
presets.summary: A tall, heavy fire column for bonfires, burning trees and wreckage.
useCases: Bonfires, burning trees and wreckage
Burning buildings and boss arenas
A signal fire that has to be visible from across a level

presets.name: Brazier Fire
presets.summary: A wide bed of flames for braziers, fire pits and burning ground.
useCases: Braziers, fire pits and burning ground
A row of torches: scale the emitter horizontally instead of placing many
Burning walls and bonfires viewed from the side

presets.name: Bubble Rise
presets.summary: Outlined bubbles floating up in pale blue.
useCases: A cute underwater or soda scene
Ambient bubbles in a bright level
A menu or a title screen that should feel light

presets.name: Bubble Trail
presets.summary: Bubbles streaming behind a swimmer, a torpedo or a propeller.
useCases: A swimming character, a fish, a submarine or a torpedo
A propeller, an outboard motor or a jet ski
Any fast object moving through water

presets.name: Bubbles
presets.summary: Bubbles that rise, wobble and speed up, for underwater scenes and potions.
useCases: Underwater levels: scatter emitters for ambient bubbles
Potions, cauldrons and alchemy, tinted to the potion's colour
Divers, submarines and leaking oxygen lines

presets.name: Bullet - Concrete
presets.summary: A puff of dust and grit where a shot hits masonry.
useCases: Bullet holes in concrete, brick and plaster
The default wall hit for a shooter
Any impact where the surface should crumble rather than shatter

presets.name: Bullet - Flesh
presets.summary: A blood burst where a shot hits a body.
useCases: Any hit on a character, enemy or animal
Gore settings on a game that wants a heavier hit
Pair with Blood Splatter for a bigger wound

presets.name: Bullet - Ice
presets.summary: Frost chips and a cold puff where a shot breaks ice.
useCases: Shots into ice walls, frozen lakes and icicles
A frost-themed game's default impact
Pair with Ice Shatter for a hit that breaks a whole frozen object

presets.name: Bullet - Metal
presets.summary: Bright sparks off a metal surface, with very little dust.
useCases: Bullet hits on metal, vehicles, robots and armour
Almost any sci-fi or industrial shooter
Pair with Bullet - Concrete on a mixed surface

presets.name: Bullet - Sand
presets.summary: A low, wide spray of sand where a shot hits loose ground.
useCases: Shots into dunes, beaches, sandbags and dry earth
Desert and coastal levels
Any surface that should absorb a hit rather than chip

presets.name: Bullet - Shield
presets.summary: A burst of light where a shot is stopped by a shield or barrier.
useCases: A projectile absorbed by a magic shield, energy barrier or force field
A hit on an invulnerable enemy or a boss's guard
Pair with Shield Block Flash for the ripple across the surface

presets.name: Bullet - Stone
presets.summary: Grey chips and a little dust where a shot hits rock.
useCases: Stone walls, cliffs, ruins, statues and gravel
A neutral impact for a game where surfaces are not distinguished
Dungeons, caves and anything carved rather than built

presets.name: Bullet - Water
presets.summary: A small vertical splash where a shot hits a water surface.
useCases: Shots into puddles, pools, rivers and the sea
Rain-heavy levels where hits should interact with the ground
The surface half of a boat or water-monster fight

presets.name: Bullet - Wood
presets.summary: Splinters and dust torn out of a wooden surface.
useCases: Crates, doors, fences, trees and wooden floors
Any hit in a game with a warm, hand-made art style
A softer alternative to Bullet - Concrete for interior walls

presets.name: Burning
presets.summary: Flames that lick up the body of a character who is on fire.
useCases: Burn and ignite statuses
Burning props and enemies that catch fire from a fire hit
Attach to the character and Start emitting while the status is active

presets.name: Button Press
presets.summary: A tiny pop of light for a button press, click or menu confirm.
useCases: Menu and HUD button presses
Click and tap confirmation on UI elements
Anywhere a click needs feedback that is smaller than a burst

presets.name: Campfire Flame
presets.summary: Rising flame tongues for campfires, torches, braziers and burning props.
useCases: Campfire, torch and brazier props
Burning buildings, candles and braziers
Scale the object left/right for wider fires, or place several in a row

presets.name: Candle Flame
presets.summary: A small steady teardrop flame for candles, lamps and small fires.
useCases: Candles, oil lamps and lanterns
Small braziers, memorial flames and shrines
A pilot light or a brazier on a character sprite

presets.name: Candy Cloud
presets.summary: A dense puff of chunky pink clouds, blown out white in the middle.
useCases: A cartoon explosion or a smoke bomb in a bright game
A pop behind a logo, a portal or a treasure
Anywhere the effect should be a shape rather than a simulation

presets.name: Candy Funnel
presets.summary: Soft pink clouds funnelling into a centre.
useCases: A portal, a vacuum or a magic gathering spell
A soft, cute version of a black hole or a whirlpool
Pair with Pop Burst at the centre for a spell that finishes

presets.name: Cartoon Hit Dust
presets.summary: The chunky, hard-edged puff of a comic impact.
useCases: A comic impact, a cartoon fight or a slapstick collision
The puff behind Cartoon Hit Stars in a platformer
Any hit in a game drawn with flat shapes and hard edges

presets.name: Cartoon Hit Stars
presets.summary: A handful of spinning stars knocked loose by a cartoon hit.
useCases: A comic or cartoon impact, over Punch Impact or Cartoon Hit Dust
A stun, a dizzy hit or a critical blow in a light-hearted game
A kids' game or a platformer where a hit should be funny, not violent

presets.name: Cave Drips
presets.summary: Water that drips from a cave roof, falling faster as it goes.
useCases: Caves, sewers, tunnels and leaking ceilings
Dungeons and mines, where the drips are part of the atmosphere
Chain a splash to where the drops die for a drip that lands

presets.name: Chain Reaction
presets.summary: An explosion that sets off smaller ones around it.
useCases: A barrel field, a fuel line or a magazine going up in sequence
A boss's death throes, with blasts crawling across the arena
A spell that spreads between targets

presets.name: Charm Burst
presets.summary: A burst of hearts and sparkles, for anything meant to be adorable.
useCases: A charm, love or friendship effect
A cute pickup, a pet or a dating-sim moment
Any game where the effect is allowed to be charming

presets.name: Chevron Volley
presets.summary: A cone of orange arrows fired in one direction.
useCases: A ranged attack, a dash or a charge in a comic style
An impact that should show the direction it came from
A pop behind a projectile as it launches

presets.name: Chill Field
presets.summary: Frost motes orbiting a character, for a cold aura.
useCases: A cold, frozen or ice-armoured character
A chill aura, a frost shield or a cryo field around an object
Tint it violet for a shadow aura, or green for poison

presets.name: Chill Snap
presets.summary: A very short burst of ice spikes at a point of contact.
useCases: A frost attack landing, or an ice arrow hitting a target
The moment a freeze spell connects
Any impact that needs to be over almost at once

presets.name: Collect Sparkle
presets.summary: A small burst of golden stars for picking something up.
useCases: Coins, gems and item pickups
Quest item collection and checkpoint touches
Quest and shop confirmations: use one particle per item collected

presets.name: Comet Ribbon
presets.summary: A ribbon of arrows and stars left behind a projectile.
useCases: A magic missile, a thrown weapon or a fast dash
A bullet in a game with a bright, graphic art style
Pair with Star Pop where the projectile lands

presets.name: Confetti Pop
presets.summary: One-shot confetti cannon: paper pieces that tumble, arc and rain back down.
useCases: Level complete, high score and reward screens
Button presses, loot drops and slot machine wins
Emitters placed at both bottom corners for a double cannon

presets.name: Confetti Rain
presets.summary: Bright confetti and stars falling across the screen.
useCases: A win, a level complete or a high score
A party or a festival scene
Pair with Star Geyser for a full celebration

presets.name: Critical Hit
presets.summary: A big radiant flash for a hit that mattered.
useCases: A critical hit, a weak point or a break in a boss's guard
The killing blow on an enemy
Reward feedback the moment a hit registers as special

presets.name: Crown Splash
presets.summary: A heavy object landing in water, throwing a crown of droplets.
useCases: A body, a boulder or a cannonball landing in water
A big creature surfacing or diving
Pair with Splash Ring for the smaller second splash that follows

presets.name: Cryo Vent
presets.summary: Cold vapour jetting from a pipe, a vent or a cracked canister.
useCases: A coolant leak, a broken pipe or a venting canister
Steam vents in a frozen industrial level
A cryo weapon's exhaust

presets.name: Cursed
presets.summary: Violet wisps of shadow that cling to a cursed character.
useCases: Curse, hex and vulnerable statuses
Undead, void corruption and boss debuffs
Retint green for a nature hex, or red for a blood curse

presets.name: Curving Trail
presets.summary: A magic ribbon that peels away from a projectile's path as it curves.
useCases: Magic bolts and enchanted arrows
Energy weapons with unstable projectiles
A dash trail that curls: pin it to the character during the dash

presets.name: Cyclone
presets.summary: A spinning funnel of wind that rises and widens as it turns.
useCases: Tornadoes, whirlwinds and dust devils
Wind magic funnels and boss arenas
Sandstorm version: retint sandy beige and switch to a Normal layer

presets.name: Damage Glint
presets.summary: A sharp flash of light for a hit, a critical or a damage number.
useCases: Damage numbers and critical hit markers
Hit markers on a crosshair or a HUD element
Confirming a click on a target, or a heal that lands

presets.name: Debris Chunks
presets.summary: Solid fragments that fly out, tumble and fall, for broken crates and rock.
useCases: Crates, barrels, pots and vases
Rock, stone and crystal breaking apart
Enemy armour breaking off: pair with Impact Sparks

presets.name: Dragon Breath
presets.summary: A wide roaring cone of fire that swells as it travels.
useCases: Dragon and boss fire breath attacks
A wide flamethrower, a furnace door opening or a rocket engine
Any cone of fire that has to fill the space in front of it

presets.name: Dust Motes
presets.summary: Tiny motes hanging and drifting in a shaft of light.
useCases: Light shafts through windows, caves and ruins
Derelict rooms, attics and abandoned buildings
Underwater silt, or snow in the air at a distance

presets.name: Earth Impact
presets.summary: Clods of earth and small stones thrown out of the ground and dropped back.
useCases: Earth, rock and stone element hits
Digging, stomps, landslips and burrowing enemies
Set Gravity lower for a dirt spray, or higher for falling rubble

presets.name: Earth Trail
presets.summary: Grit and dust that falls away behind a heavy projectile.
useCases: Boulder, rock and thrown-weapon projectiles
Drills, digging machines and burrowing enemies
Set Gravity to 0 for grit that hangs in the air

presets.name: Electric Cage
presets.summary: Arcs that crackle around a ring, like a barrier holding something in.
useCases: Prison and trap effects, and enemies held in place
Energy shields, fences and sci-fi barriers
Stun rings: shrink the radius and raise the rate for a tighter cage

presets.name: Electric Sparks
presets.summary: Sharp electric arcs that crackle out of a hit or a broken machine.
useCases: Electric damage, stun hits and shield breaks
Broken machinery, exposed cables and short circuits
Tesla coils and energy weapons: keep Auto emit on and drop the rate for a continuous crackle

presets.name: Ember Drift
presets.summary: Slow embers floating up from a fire, for depth and atmosphere.
useCases: Anything already using Campfire Flame, Brazier Fire or Bonfire Column
Fires seen from a distance, where the flame itself is too small to read
Embers rising through a dark scene as the only light source

presets.name: Ember Pinwheel
presets.summary: Fast spinning wheels of fire, for fireworks, spells and machinery.
useCases: Firework wheels and spinning firework parts
A spinning fire spell, trap or mechanism
The rotating blades of a fire elemental or a burning machine

presets.name: Ember Rain
presets.summary: Embers falling from above, for burning ceilings and volcanic skies.
useCases: Burning buildings, collapsing ceilings and volcanic skies
A level-wide ambience layer above the camera
The aftermath of a large explosion

presets.name: Ember Scatter
presets.summary: A handful of embers thrown out by a fire or a burning hit.
useCases: Spawned from Fire Burst's On Death, and from Campfire Flame at a low chance for a fire that throws sparks
Struck metal, struck flint and bullet impacts on hot surfaces
Bonfires and forges that occasionally throw a spark

presets.name: Embers
presets.summary: Glowing embers that lift off a fire, drift and cool to deep red.
useCases: Campfires, braziers, forges and torches
Burning buildings and volcanic scenes
Burning debris: spawn this emitter once where something catches fire

presets.name: Explosion Blast
presets.summary: A one-shot fireball that swells into a ragged cloud, for barrels and grenades.
useCases: Grenades, mines and exploding barrels
Enemy and boss deaths
Pair with Smoke Plume for the cloud that follows, and Debris Chunks for what the blast threw off

presets.name: Fire Burst
presets.summary: A flare of fire that bursts from a hit and breaks apart in half a second.
useCases: Fire and lava element hits
Explosive rounds, torches and burning enemies
Chain it: point On Death > Spawn object at another one-shot emitter (Debris Chunks, say) with a Spawn chance below 100%

presets.name: Fire Jet
presets.summary: Aiming fire jet for flamethrowers, dragons' throats and burning vents.
useCases: Flamethrowers, flame turrets and burning vents
Dragon breath and fire breath attacks
A jet of flame a character or vehicle can aim

presets.name: Fire Tornado
presets.summary: A spinning column of flame for firestorms, fire elementals and hazards.
useCases: A fire tornado hazard or a fire elemental's body
Burning vortices and firestorms
A boss arena effect that has to read as dangerous from any angle

presets.name: Fire Trail
presets.summary: Embers and flame that stream back and cool behind a burning projectile.
useCases: Fire arrows, flaming bullets and meteor projectiles
Fireballs: pair with a Fire Burst spawned when the shot lands
Campfire sparks by setting Speed to 0 and turning off Direction

presets.name: Fireball Bloom
presets.summary: A slow, rolling fireball that keeps growing as it drifts.
useCases: Fuel explosions, spells and magical detonations
A blast that should hang in the air rather than snap
The core of a large set-piece, with the debris added separately

presets.name: Fireball Impact
presets.summary: A one-shot fireball burst that leaves smoke behind where it lands.
useCases: Fireballs, incendiary grenades and burning projectiles
Anything that should leave a puff of smoke where it lands
Spawned from a hit event at the point of contact

presets.name: Fireflies
presets.summary: Glowing motes that drift upward and flicker on their own timing.
useCases: Forest, swamp and night levels
Fairy dust and magic motes: retint to pink or blue
Set Emit from edge with a larger radius to ring an object instead

presets.name: Flame Overlay
presets.summary: A small flame that sits on a character or object without moving with it.
useCases: A character or enemy that is on fire
A burning weapon, shield or vehicle
A prop that should keep its flames while it moves

presets.name: Flare Signal
presets.summary: A burning flare that arcs up, hangs and falls back.
useCases: A distress flare or a signal shot
An incendiary round or a burning arrow
A spell that lobs a ball of light over a wall

presets.name: Flash Bang
presets.summary: A white flash and a scatter of light, for stuns and screen-clearing hits.
useCases: Flashbangs, stun grenades and blinding spells
A hit that clears the screen for a moment
The flash at the centre of a much larger explosion

presets.name: Foam Burst
presets.summary: A cloud of white foam, for the end of a wave or a heavy splash.
useCases: The foam left after a wave breaks or something lands in water
A hot tub, a fountain basin or a ship's wake
Pair with Crown Splash for the splash and this for what is left

presets.name: Fog Roll-in
presets.summary: A bank of fog crossing the frame from one side.
useCases: Fog arriving across a field, a road or a harbour
A scene transition where visibility closes in
The middle distance of a layered weather scene

presets.name: Freezing Mist
presets.summary: Cold haze lying over frozen ground, water and low ground.
useCases: Frozen ground, ice caves and cold rooms
A thin layer over a frozen lake, or under a snowfall
Anywhere a warm Ground Fog would be wrong

presets.name: Freezing Rain
presets.summary: Sleet driving down at an angle, between rain and snow.
useCases: Sleet, freezing rain and icy storms
A level where the weather should look painful rather than pretty
Layered under snow for a mixed winter storm

presets.name: Frost Breath
presets.summary: A cone of cold vapour, for frost attacks and freezing machines.
useCases: A frost attack, a cold breath weapon or a freezing spell
A coolant leak, an extinguisher or a vent of cold gas
Aimed, so rotate the object: direction 0 points right

presets.name: Frost Motes
presets.summary: Pale specks of frost left hanging where an ice hit landed.
useCases: Spawned from Ice Shards' On Death to leave frost hanging in the air
Cold rooms, freezers and breath in winter air
Freeze effects: spawn these on the target as the freeze lands

presets.name: Frost Nova
presets.summary: A ring of freezing vapour that blasts outward and hangs there.
useCases: A frost nova, an ice barrier or a freezing shockwave
An area-of-effect spell that should show its radius
Rings around a target: match the circle radius to the sprite

presets.name: Frost Ring
presets.summary: A ring of ice shards that snaps out of a point and blows open.
useCases: Frost novas, freeze bursts and ice barriers
Rings around a target: match the Circle radius to the sprite
Retint pale blue for frost, red for a fire nova, violet for shadow

presets.name: Frozen
presets.summary: Frost crystals and cold mist clinging to a frozen character.
useCases: Freeze and slow statuses
Enemies caught in an ice hit, or characters standing in a cold room
Attach to the character while the status is active

presets.name: Furnace Glow
presets.summary: A pulsing glow inside an opening, for furnaces, forges and vents.
useCases: Furnace, forge and oven mouths
Lit windows in a dark building, or a glowing cave entrance
The inside of an engine, reactor or boiler

presets.name: Fuse Sparkle
presets.summary: A bright spitting spark at the end of a fuse or a fuse-like device.
useCases: A bomb or barrel with a lit fuse
A damaged device about to blow, or a timed trap
Animating a fuse that has to read at a glance

presets.name: Geyser Eruption
presets.summary: A fountain of water thrown up out of the ground, for two seconds.
useCases: A geyser, a burst water main or a whale's blowhole
A hazard that erupts on a cycle
Pair with Hot Spring Steam at the base and Crown Splash where it lands

presets.name: Glacial Impact
presets.summary: The big one: a comet of ice landing and exploding into shards.
useCases: An ice comet, a glacial spell or a frozen meteor landing
A boss attack that has to read as enormous
The moment a frozen structure finally gives way

presets.name: Glow Motes
presets.summary: A few sparks of light that pop out of a radiant hit and vanish.
useCases: Spawned from Light Burst's On Death, and from Heal Aura while healing
Pickups, checkpoints and ability procs
Palette swap for other energies: cyan for arcane, green for nature

presets.name: Goo Pop
presets.summary: Fat blobs of bright purple goo thrown outward.
useCases: A slime or ooze enemy bursting
A cartoon hit in a game with a gross-out streak
A potion or a chemical reaction

presets.name: Gravity Well
presets.summary: Grit and dust pulled inwards to a point, accelerating as it falls in.
useCases: Black holes, vacuums and suction traps
Magnet pulls and absorb abilities
Flip Direction mode to Outwards for a repulsor field

presets.name: Grenade Bounce Spark
presets.summary: A small spark where something hard skips off a surface.
useCases: A grenade, casing or metal object bouncing off a hard surface
A cannonball skipping, or debris landing on stone
A trap or a hazard that has to feel physical

presets.name: Grenade Explosion
presets.summary: A fireball with debris thrown out of it, for fragmentation blasts.
useCases: Fragmentation grenades, mines and cluster bombs
Anything that should scatter debris as well as burn
Boss attacks that fill an area with shrapnel

presets.name: Ground Fog
presets.summary: Low fog that drifts across the ground and thins as it goes.
useCases: Swamps, graveyards and cold mornings
Depth in a flat scene: one layer behind the action, one in front
Wind direction: set Direction to 0 or 180 to blow the fog sideways

presets.name: Ground Splash Field
presets.summary: A field of small splashes where rain meets the ground.
useCases: The floor of any scene with rain in it
Puddles, wet streets and stone courtyards
Pair with Rain - Heavy or Rain - Storm so the drops land

presets.name: Hail Fall
presets.summary: Ice stones falling with the rain in a violent storm.
useCases: A violent storm or a freak weather event
Hail as a hazard in a level
Pair with Rain - Storm and Ground Splash Field for the full picture

presets.name: Hail Storm
presets.summary: Heavy ice stones hammering down, for damaging storms.
useCases: A hail storm as a level hazard or a spell
Falling ice from a collapsing glacier
Any storm that should visibly hit the ground

presets.name: Hammer Impact
presets.summary: A ring of dust and debris driven out along the ground.
useCases: A hammer or axe slam, a ground pound or a boss stomp
A landing heavy enough to shake the floor
Pair with Shockwave Burst for a hit that reads across the whole screen

presets.name: Heal Aura
presets.summary: Soft motes of green light that rise around a character and fade.
useCases: Healing, regeneration and revives
Buff auras on a weapon, a shield or a shrine
Retint to red for damage-over-time, or to blue for a mana aura

presets.name: Heart Fountain
presets.summary: Hearts drifting up in a steady stream.
useCases: A love or affection meter that is filling up
A cute character's idle effect
A menu or a chat emote

presets.name: Heat Shimmer
presets.summary: A faint wavering haze above hot ground, lava and engines.
useCases: Above lava, hot coals, asphalt and engine cowlings
Over a desert or a fire to sell the temperature
A subtle layer over any fire whose flames are already doing the work

presets.name: Hot Spring Steam
presets.summary: Slow vapour rising off a hot pool or a spring.
useCases: A hot spring, a geyser pool or a heated pool
Water in a cold level, where the contrast does the work
Pair with Underwater Stream below the surface and Geyser Eruption above

presets.name: Ice Crack Spread
presets.summary: Cracks that race outward from a point, for breaking ice.
useCases: Breaking ice underfoot, or a frozen floor giving way
The moment before a frozen object shatters
A frost spell landing on stone, glass or a shield

presets.name: Ice Crystals Forming
presets.summary: Crystals that grow out of nothing and stop, for a target freezing over.
useCases: A character or object freezing solid
Ice spreading across a floor, a lock or a window
The build-up before a frost attack lands

presets.name: Ice Shards
presets.summary: Splinters of ice that spray out of a hit, stretched along their flight.
useCases: Ice and frost element hits
Freeze, slow and shatter abilities
Ring a frozen enemy: turn on Emit from edge with a radius that matches the sprite

presets.name: Ice Shatter
presets.summary: A one-shot burst of ice chips, for breaking a frozen object.
useCases: Breaking a frozen crate, lock, statue or bridge
An ice spell landing on a target
Any hit that should look like glass breaking rather than dust

presets.name: Ice Sparkle
presets.summary: Twinkling glints on a frozen surface, for ice that catches the light.
useCases: Frozen lakes, ice walls, icicles and frost-covered ground
Any surface that should look cold and reflective
A reward or pickup sitting on ice

presets.name: Ice Trail
presets.summary: Frost and splinters that are left shimmering along a projectile's path.
useCases: Ice arrows, frost bolts and chilling projectiles
Frozen projectiles that shatter: follow the shot with Ice Shards
Retint to white for snow, or to pale green for a crystal shot

presets.name: Icicle Break
presets.summary: Chunks of ice falling from a roof, ledge or branch.
useCases: Ice breaking off a roof, a cliff or a frozen branch
A collapsing glacier or an ice cave ceiling
A hazard above a corridor that drops ice on the player

presets.name: Icicle Drip
presets.summary: Meltwater dripping from an icicle, ledge or cave roof.
useCases: Icicles, cave roofs and stone ledges in a cold level
Melting ice, frozen pipes and thawing machinery
A quiet ambience layer above a frozen pond

presets.name: Impact Sparks
presets.summary: One-shot spark spray with gravity arcs, for hits, ricochets and metal on metal.
useCases: Bullet impacts on metal, stone and shields
Sword clashes, mining and grinding
Fire Emit particles (34) in an event to fire it on demand

presets.name: Landing Dust
presets.summary: A low puff of dust kicked up by a landing, a dash or a heavy step.
useCases: Landing after a jump, fall or roll
The start and end of a dash or dodge
Footsteps: emit one or two particles from an event on each step

presets.name: Lava Bubbles
presets.summary: Bubbles that swell on a lava surface and pop in a burst of heat.
useCases: Lava pools, magma rivers and volcano levels
Acid and swamp pools: retint green with Normal blending
Pair with Ember Scatter chained from this emitter for sparks

presets.name: Level Up Burst
presets.summary: A burst of gold stars thrown out from a reward, score or level up.
useCases: Level ups, quest completions and score milestones
Coins, chests and pickup collections
Achievement popups: fire it behind the panel in the UI layer

presets.name: Light Burst
presets.summary: A flash of radiant light that blooms from a hit and fades in a blink.
useCases: Light and holy element hits
Flashbangs, ability procs and critical hits
Palette swap for other energies: cyan for arcane, green for nature

presets.name: Light Trail
presets.summary: Sparkling motes of light that bloom and fade along a projectile's path.
useCases: Light and holy projectiles, energy bolts and healer's arrows
Palette swap for other energies: cyan for arcane, green for nature
A short, bright trail: drop Lifetime to 0.2 for a tight streak

presets.name: Magma Geyser
presets.summary: A fountain of molten rock thrown up and falling back.
useCases: Lava vents, volcanic cracks and molten metal pouring
A hazard that throws burning debris into the air on a cycle
The base of a lava fountain in a boss arena

presets.name: Magma Splash
presets.summary: Molten blobs thrown out of lava in a ballistic arc.
useCases: Lava bubbles popping, volcanic impacts and molten metal
A fire spell that throws burning debris
Any impact that should leave a few burning droplets behind

presets.name: Menu Trail
presets.summary: A soft trail of light that follows a menu cursor or a dragged item.
useCases: Menu cursors and selection highlights
Dragged items, sliders and scroll lists
A chosen button that should feel alive: keep Auto emit on while it is highlighted

presets.name: Meteor Shower
presets.summary: A run of meteors crossing the sky together.
useCases: A meteor shower, a comet passing or a sky falling
A magical night, a prophecy or a boss's arrival
Pair with Night Sky Twinkle so the sky is not empty between meteors

presets.name: Mine Blast
presets.summary: A short, violent eruption of dirt and sparks from the ground.
useCases: Land mines, spike traps and buried charges
A hazard that fires when the player walks over it
Pair with Fuse Sparkle for the moment before it goes off

presets.name: Mint Cloud
presets.summary: The Candy Cloud in mint green.
useCases: A nature, ice or water themed pop
A healing or a shield effect in a bright game
Anywhere the pink version is too warm

presets.name: Missile Launch
presets.summary: A heavy exhaust plume down and out from a launcher.
useCases: Rocket and missile launchers, jetpacks and jump jets
A vehicle taking off or a thruster firing
Pair with Flash Bang at the nozzle and Missile Trail on the projectile

presets.name: Missile Trail
presets.summary: A ribbon of smoke left behind a rocket in flight.
useCases: Rockets, missiles and guided projectiles in flight
A rocket jump or a burning projectile
Pair with Missile Launch at the start and Small Explosion at the end

presets.name: Molten Drip
presets.summary: Heavy burning drops falling from a ceiling, ledge or blade.
useCases: Molten metal dripping from a ceiling or a broken pipe
A burning ledge, a damaged robot or a lava tube
Drips from a weapon or a torch held overhead

presets.name: Morning Mist
presets.summary: Still, low haze that hangs over the ground without moving.
useCases: A dawn level, a field, a lake or a graveyard
Low ground cover in a forest or a valley
Pair with Sunbeam Dust for early morning light

presets.name: Mud Splatter
presets.summary: Heavy mud thrown out by a wheel, a boot or an impact.
useCases: A wheel, a tracked vehicle or a boot in wet ground
A creature emerging from a swamp or a bog
A heavy impact on wet earth

presets.name: Mud Trail
presets.summary: A line of mud splashes left behind a moving wheel or boot.
useCases: A car, a bike or a tracked vehicle in wet ground
A creature or a character running through a swamp
Pair with Mud Splatter on the wheel itself

presets.name: Muzzle Flash
presets.summary: A bright flash that grows, frays and vanishes in a tenth of a second.
useCases: Firearms, turrets and tank barrels
Energy and laser weapons: retint to blue or green
Fire Restart emitter from an event so every shot flashes exactly once

presets.name: Nebula Spiral
presets.summary: A dense violet spiral of chunky motes.
useCases: A portal, a vortex or a magical charge-up
A colourful background effect for a menu or a boss
Anywhere the motion itself is the point

presets.name: Night Sky Twinkle
presets.summary: A field of stars that brighten and dim in place.
useCases: A night sky, a cave roof or a background for a title screen
Depth behind a level that takes place at night
Pair with Shooting Star and Fireflies for a full night scene

presets.name: Ocean Spray
presets.summary: Wind-blown spray off the top of a breaking wave.
useCases: A shoreline, a storm at sea or a ship in rough water
The crest of a breaking wave, on a wide emitter
Pair with Wave Crash Mist and Wave Foam for a full break

presets.name: Orbit Ring
presets.summary: Motes that circle a point instead of leaving it, like a small halo orbit.
useCases: Orbiting shields, familiars and magic shields
Halo effects for powered-up characters and legendary items
Satellites, drones and orbiting debris

presets.name: Overhang Drips
presets.summary: Water dripping from a roof edge, a ledge or a branch.
useCases: A roof edge, an awning, a branch or a cave lip
A tunnel, a bridge or a leaky pipe running along the ceiling
After rain: the water that keeps coming down after the storm

presets.name: Parry Sparks
presets.summary: A tight fan of sparks where two blades meet.
useCases: A successful parry, or a clash between two weapons
A deflection in a game built around timing
Pair with Shield Block Flash for a parry that also flashes

presets.name: Poisoned
presets.summary: Sickly green bubbles that rise off a poisoned character and drift away.
useCases: Poison and toxic statuses
Swamps, sewers and lab hazards
Retint to purple for a curse, or to blue for a mana drain

presets.name: Pollen Drift
presets.summary: Golden pollen hanging in warm afternoon air.
useCases: A summer field, a meadow or a garden
A warm outdoor level with no other weather
Pair with Sakura Drift or Autumn Leaves for a season

presets.name: Pop Burst
presets.summary: A fat pink cloud that blooms out of a point.
useCases: A hit, a pickup or a reward in a game with a bright art style
A confetti-like pop behind a menu or a button
Anywhere the effect should be seen rather than believed

presets.name: Pop Ring
presets.summary: A thick ring that snaps outward and flashes.
useCases: A hit, a landing or a spell with a visible radius
A button press or a menu confirmation
A ring to put around a target: match the circle radius to the sprite

presets.name: Pop Ring - Prism
presets.summary: The Pop Ring in blue, stepping from pale to deep as it expands.
useCases: A magical or prismatic effect where the colours should read in order
A reward, a portal or a spell
A colourful ring around a character or an object

presets.name: Prism Halo
presets.summary: A halo of shifting colours that walks through a palette as it rings an object.
useCases: Legendary items, buffs and powered-up characters
Portals, shrines and collectibles that should catch the eye
One colour only: clear the tints list and the single tint takes over

presets.name: Punch Impact
presets.summary: A small puff where a fist lands, with no sparks or debris.
useCases: Punches, kicks and unarmed hits
The contact frame of a brawler or a platformer attack
Pair with Cartoon Hit Stars or Cartoon Hit Dust for the full cartoon hit

presets.name: Rain - Heavy
presets.summary: Dense, fast rain that fills the screen.
useCases: A downpour, a storm scene or a dramatic moment
A level where the rain is the mood rather than the backdrop
Pair with Ground Splash Field so the rain lands somewhere

presets.name: Rain - Light
presets.summary: Sparse, slow rain for a drizzle or a wet afternoon.
useCases: A drizzle, a wet afternoon or a light shower
Interiors seen through a window, or a level with a roof
The cheap rain layer for a mobile or web build

presets.name: Rain - Storm
presets.summary: Slanted, wind-driven rain with a second layer of spray behind it.
useCases: A storm, a hurricane or a squall at sea
Rain that should look like it is being driven by wind
Pair with Cyclone or Wind Gust for the wind itself

presets.name: Rainbow Fountain
presets.summary: A fountain of chunky clouds in every colour.
useCases: A celebration, a fountain or a party effect
A reward moment in a bright game
Pair with Confetti Rain for a full celebration

presets.name: Rainfall
presets.summary: Streaked rain falling fast across a wide band, ready for any scene.
useCases: Rain and thunderstorms
Wind: set Gravity to 200 with Gravity angle 130 to slant the streaks
Drips and downpours: raise the Emission rate to 120 for a storm

presets.name: Ricochet - Metal
presets.summary: A long fan of sparks thrown off a glancing metal hit.
useCases: Shots glancing off armour, vehicles and metal walls
A hit that should tell the player the shot did not penetrate
Pair with Ricochet - Stone for a wall with mixed materials

presets.name: Ricochet - Stone
presets.summary: Chips skipping off a glancing hit on rock or concrete.
useCases: Glancing shots off stone, concrete and brick
Ruins, tunnels and anywhere the surface should chip rather than spark
A ricochet in a game with no metal in it

presets.name: Ricochet Sparks
presets.summary: Sparks that each pick their own curve and keep changing course.
useCases: Ricochets off metal, stone and shields
Sparks from grinding, welding and cutting
Chaotic debris from an energy discharge

presets.name: RPG Backblast
presets.summary: The cone of dust and smoke thrown back by a shoulder-fired launcher.
useCases: Shoulder-fired launchers, recoilless rifles and rocket jumps
A weapon that should push dust away from the shooter
Pair with Missile Launch at the front of the same weapon

presets.name: Rune Circle
presets.summary: A ring of glowing runes that stays lit under or around an object.
useCases: Magic circles, summoning rings and teleport pads
Buffs and shields that should ring the character
Retint to one colour for a plain aura, or leave the palette for a ritual

presets.name: Sakura Drift
presets.summary: Falling cherry blossom petals tumbling across the screen.
useCases: Spring and Japanese-themed levels
Wind gusts: rotate the object to change the drift direction
Ambient depth: one wide emitter behind the action, one small one in front

presets.name: Sandstorm
presets.summary: Driving sand and haze across a desert level.
useCases: A desert level, a dust storm or a wasteland
Weather as an obstacle: a storm that has to be walked through
Pair with a darker light layer to sell the reduced visibility

presets.name: Score Ticker
presets.summary: Sparkles that rise off a score or counter while it counts up.
useCases: Score and combo counters while they count up
Experience bars, gold totals and damage-total readouts
Slot machines and reward screens: raise the rate for a payout

presets.name: Shadow Burst
presets.summary: Wisps of violet shadow that bloom out of a hit and curl away.
useCases: Dark and shadow element hits
Curses, drains, hexes and necromancy
Retint: green for poison, red for blood magic, blue for void

presets.name: Shadow Motes
presets.summary: Wisps of shadow that curl out of a dark hit and sink away.
useCases: Spawned from Shadow Burst's On Death
Hexes, drains and cursed weapons
Retint green for poison, red for blood magic, blue for spirit flame

presets.name: Shadow Trail
presets.summary: Wisps of violet shadow that trail a projectile and curl away.
useCases: Dark and void projectiles, cursed arrows and thrown hexes
Enemy attacks that should read as corrupt: pair with Shadow Burst
Retint green for poison, red for blood magic, blue for spirit fire

presets.name: Shell Casings
presets.summary: Brass cases thrown out of a gun, tumbling and falling to the ground.
useCases: Gunfire: restart emitter once per shot, or emit one particle
Top-down shooters: set Gravity to 0 and lower Drag
Shotgun reloads and dramatic close-ups

presets.name: Shield Block Flash
presets.summary: A ripple of light that spreads across a shield and stalls.
useCases: A projectile or a blow absorbed by a shield, barrier or bubble
A hit on an invulnerable enemy
Pair with Bullet - Shield or Parry Sparks for the sparks

presets.name: Shocked
presets.summary: Electric arcs that crackle over a shocked character.
useCases: Shock, stun and paralysis statuses
Robots and machinery shorting out
Pair with a stun: the flicker reads as the character being unable to act

presets.name: Shockwave Burst
presets.summary: A dust ring that snaps outward, stalls in mid-air and hangs there.
useCases: Ground slams, heavy landings and boss stomps
Explosions that need a visible blast radius, rather than a fireball
Set Gravity to 0 and raise the speed for a shockwave in mid-air

presets.name: Shockwave Dust Ring
presets.summary: A flat ring of dust driven along the ground by a blast.
useCases: The ground shockwave of a large blast or a heavy landing
Artillery and bombing runs
Pair with Smoke Ring Blast for a blast with both air and ground waves

presets.name: Shooting Star
presets.summary: A single streak across the sky, spawned for the moment.
useCases: A night sky, a wish or a moment of wonder
Rare ambience in a desert, a mountain or a space scene
The moment the sky opens in a story beat

presets.name: Sleet
presets.summary: The middle ground between rain and snow, falling fast and pale.
useCases: Cold rain, sleet and freezing drizzle
A city or road in winter, where the weather is a nuisance
Use it instead of Rain - Light when the level is frozen

presets.name: Slime Drip
presets.summary: Thick goo stretching and dripping from a ceiling or a creature.
useCases: A slime, a creature, a stalactite of goo or a leaking pipe
A toxic or alien environment where the liquid is not water
Pair with Slime Splat where the drops land

presets.name: Slime Splat
presets.summary: A gooey impact that leaves a few drops behind.
useCases: Slime hitting a wall, a floor or a character
A gooey projectile bursting, or a creature being hit
Chained from Slime Drip where it lands

presets.name: Small Explosion
presets.summary: A compact fireball for grenades, hits and small props.
useCases: Grenades, rockets and explosive hits
Barrels and small props breaking
Any blast that should not dominate the frame

presets.name: Smoke Plume
presets.summary: Slow rising smoke that swells and fades, for chimneys, wreckage and campfires.
useCases: Chimneys, campfires and burnt-out props
Wreckage, vehicle exhaust and factory vents
Steam vents: swap the tint to white and shorten the lifetime

presets.name: Smoke Puff
presets.summary: One soft puff of smoke that swells and fades, for blasts and impacts.
useCases: Spawned from Explosion Blast's On Death to leave smoke behind
Gunshots, ricochets and metal impacts
Exhaust, steam vents and dust kicked up by falling objects

presets.name: Smoke Ring Blast
presets.summary: A ring of smoke driven outward from a blast, hanging in the air.
useCases: The air shockwave of a large blast
A smoke grenade, a dust ring or a pressure wave
Pair with Shockwave Dust Ring for a blast with both air and ground

presets.name: Snow - Blizzard
presets.summary: Dense, wind-driven snow that cuts visibility.
useCases: A blizzard, a mountain pass or a whiteout
Weather as an obstacle: reduced visibility in a level
Pair with Blizzard, Freezing Mist and Wind Gust for a full storm

presets.name: Snow - Light
presets.summary: Sparse, drifting snow for a calm winter scene.
useCases: A calm winter level, a village at night or a quiet scene
The far layer of a heavier snowfall
Anywhere Snowfall is too busy

presets.name: Snow Gust
presets.summary: Waves of snow driven across the frame by a gusting wind.
useCases: Snow blowing across a road, a roof or a mountain path
Wind that arrives in bursts rather than blowing steadily
Pair with Snow - Light between gusts for a mixed sky

presets.name: Snow Puff
presets.summary: A small burst of snow where something lands, or where a drop hits.
useCases: A character or object landing in snow
Chained from Icicle Drip or Hail Storm where they hit the ground
A small impact on a frozen surface

presets.name: Snow Tornado
presets.summary: A swirling column of snow and ice, for storms and blizzard spirits.
useCases: A snow devil, a blizzard elemental or a frozen hazard
A whirlwind crossing a frozen level
A column of ice and snow rising out of a crack in the ground

presets.name: Snowfall
presets.summary: Slow falling snow across a wide band, every flake drifting on its own.
useCases: Winter and snow levels
Scale it to any screen: Box width sets how much of the view it covers
Retint to grey for ashfall, or to pink for blossom in the air

presets.name: Soda Fizz
presets.summary: A fast column of tiny bubbles, for drinks and chemical reactions.
useCases: A glass, a bottle or a potion in an adventure game
A chemical reaction, a cauldron or an alchemical bench
A leak in a pressurised pipe, seen close up

presets.name: Soot Puffs
presets.summary: Short dark puffs of soot thrown off a fire, for torches and chimneys.
useCases: Chained from Torch Flame, Brazier Fire or Bonfire Column
Chimneys, exhausts and diesel engines
Muzzle smoke from a weapon that has been fired a lot

presets.name: Spark Scatter
presets.summary: A few bright sparks thrown off a metal hit, flying out and cooling.
useCases: Spawned from Impact Sparks and Electric Sparks' On Death
Bullets on metal, armour, shields and machinery
Pickaxes and mining: pair with Debris Chunks

presets.name: Speed Lines
presets.summary: Bold dashes flying outward, the comic way to show a burst.
useCases: A dash, a teleport or a sudden burst of speed
An impact in a comic or anime-styled game
A pop that has to read instantly at any size

presets.name: Speed Lines - Neon
presets.summary: The Speed Lines in neon violet, for a cyber or music-game look.
useCases: A cyberpunk, synthwave or music-game burst
A teleport or a dash in a neon art style
A pop on a black background that has to glow

presets.name: Splash Ring
presets.summary: A ring of droplets thrown out from a surface impact.
useCases: A drop, a stone or a body landing in water
The base of a waterfall or a drain
Chained from anything that falls into water

presets.name: Splat Pop
presets.summary: Lime paint splats thrown out from a point.
useCases: A paint, ink or graffiti themed game
A gooey hit in a cartoon platformer
Confetti-like chaos behind a title or a transition

presets.name: Star Geyser
presets.summary: Stars fired straight up and tumbling back down.
useCases: A win, a level complete or a boss defeat
A celebration at the end of a level
A pop behind a UI element that has to be seen across the room

presets.name: Star Pop
presets.summary: A burst of fat gold stars and sparkles.
useCases: A critical hit, a stun or a reward in a cartoon game
A pickup or a level-up pop
Anywhere the effect should look drawn rather than simulated

presets.name: Star Ring
presets.summary: A tight ring of stars opening outward from a point.
useCases: A reward, a level-up or a boss entrance
A magical barrier or a shield popping
A ring of stars around a character

presets.name: Steam Vent
presets.summary: White steam jetting out of a pipe or vent and fading fast.
useCases: Steam pipes, vents and pressure valves
Industrial levels, trains and factories
Geothermal vents and hot springs: slow it down and raise the size

presets.name: Structure Collapse
presets.summary: Debris raining out of a failing structure, for collapses and cave-ins.
useCases: A building, tower or bridge coming down
A cave-in or a tunnel collapse
The aftermath of a large explosion, while the dust settles

presets.name: Sunbeam Dust
presets.summary: Dust turning slowly in shafts of light.
useCases: Sunlight through windows, cracked roofs or a forest canopy
God rays, dusty rooms and abandoned buildings
Pair with Morning Mist for a scene in early light

presets.name: Sunset Cloud
presets.summary: The Candy Cloud in hot orange.
useCases: A magical explosion in a cartoon RPG
A pop for a fire, sun or desert themed game that should not look like real fire
A hit in a game with a warm palette

presets.name: Surface Ripples
presets.summary: Tiny droplets snapping up and falling back off a water surface.
useCases: Rain falling on a puddle, a pond or a roof
A disturbed water surface of any kind
Pair with Rainfall above it so the rain has somewhere to land

presets.name: Swirl Pop
presets.summary: Mint arrowheads whirling outward in a burst.
useCases: A spin attack or a whirlwind move
A bright, energetic hit
A pop behind a logo or a title

presets.name: Sword Hit Blood
presets.summary: A forward spray of blood where a blade cuts.
useCases: A cutting attack landing on a character
The blade's path on a heavy attack, spawned along the swing
Pair with Bleeding on the target for a wound that persists

presets.name: Sword Hit Blunt
presets.summary: A heavy dust puff where a blunt weapon lands.
useCases: A hammer, mace, shield bash or fist landing on a wall or a body
The moment a heavy attack connects
Pair with Hammer Impact for a hit that also shakes the ground

presets.name: Sword Hit Sparks
presets.summary: A forward spray of sparks where a blade lands on metal or armour.
useCases: A sword, axe or hammer landing on metal, armour or stone
A block or a clash between two blades
Pair with Sword Slash Arc on the same swing

presets.name: Thunder Flash
presets.summary: A wide flash of light across the sky, for storms and strange skies.
useCases: A storm scene, where the sky lights up every few seconds
Heat lightning, a strange sky or a distant battle
Pair with Shocked or Lightning Impact for a strike that also hits

presets.name: Torch Flame
presets.summary: A taller, livelier flame for torches, sconces and carried lights.
useCases: Wall torches, sconces and braziers
A torch carried by a character, on a Relative layer
Fire arrows and burning brands in flight

presets.name: Toxic Gas
presets.summary: A green cloud that rolls out of a vent, swells and thins as it rises.
useCases: Swamps, sewers and laboratories
Leaking barrels, vents and chemical spills
Retint to purple, brown or grey to turn it into any kind of vapour

presets.name: Underwater Stream
presets.summary: A steady column of bubbles rising through still water.
useCases: Underwater levels: the ambient bubbles a scene needs to feel submerged
A diver, a vent or a sunken wreck
Pair with Caustic-style light layers and a blue tint over the level

presets.name: Vehicle Explosion
presets.summary: Black smoke boiling out of a wreck, with secondary pops.
useCases: Vehicles, tanks, generators and fuel fires
A wreck that keeps burning after the blast
Pair with Barrel Explosion for the pieces and Big Explosion for the flash

presets.name: Void Vortex
presets.summary: Wisps that spiral inwards and vanish into the middle.
useCases: Portals, rifts and black holes
Dark magic that draws in and consumes
Reverse it into a blast: set Direction mode to Outwards and swap the speeds

presets.name: Vortex Spiral
presets.summary: Curling streaks that sweep around a ring and bend away like a vortex.
useCases: Portals, whirlwinds and tornado funnels
Wind magic and dash trails that curve
True spiral arms: rotate the emitter over time and the paths follow it

presets.name: Wall Breach
presets.summary: A hole punched in a wall, throwing chunks and dust inward.
useCases: A wall blown open by a charge or a heavy hit
Covers, barricades and destructible scenery
A tank or a boss breaking through a building

presets.name: Wall of Fire
presets.summary: A line of flames along a chosen direction, for burning barriers and rooms.
useCases: A burning wall, fence or doorway blocking a route
A wall of fire spell, or a hazard that has to follow a level edge
Line the top of a building or a pit with flames

presets.name: Water Fountain
presets.summary: A jet of water that arcs up out of a nozzle and falls back down.
useCases: Fountains, springs, geysers and broken pipes
Watering cans, hoses and pressure jets
Retint to orange for lava, or to brown for mud: the drops are white

presets.name: Water Jet
presets.summary: A tight stream of water, for hoses, leaks and broken pipes.
useCases: A hose, a fire hose or a water cannon
A burst pipe, a leaking tank or a pressure valve
The nozzle of a fountain

presets.name: Water Splash
presets.summary: A fan of drops thrown up from a surface, arcing back down again.
useCases: Anything landing in water, from bullets to boats
Puddles, drains and shallow water
Rain: emit one burst wherever a raindrop strikes

presets.name: Waterfall Mist
presets.summary: Mist that wells up from the foot of a waterfall and drifts away.
useCases: Waterfalls, cascades and weirs
Rivers, rapids and waves breaking on rocks
Retint blue-white for cold climates, or grey for a muddy river

presets.name: Waterfall Sheet
presets.summary: A thick curtain of falling water, for waterfalls and spillways.
useCases: Waterfalls, spillways, broken pipes and aqueducts
A curtain of water in front of a cave or a door
Anything pouring rather than splashing

presets.name: Wave Crash Mist
presets.summary: The white burst of mist where a wave breaks.
useCases: A wave breaking on a shore, a rock or a ship's hull
A heavy object hitting water and throwing up a cloud
Pair with Ocean Spray above it and Wave Foam below

presets.name: Wave Foam
presets.summary: The line of white foam where water meets a shore.
useCases: The waterline of a beach, a lake or a harbour wall
Water lapping at a boat, a pier or a rock
Pair with Ocean Spray and Wave Crash Mist for a surf line

presets.name: Weapon Trail
presets.summary: A smear of air left along a weapon's path, for swings and spins.
useCases: A sword, axe or claw swing, attached to the weapon
A spin attack, a dash or a whirlwind move
A thrown weapon or a chain, following its own path

presets.name: Whirlpool Motes
presets.summary: Foam and droplets spiralling into a centre.
useCases: A whirlpool, a drain, a maelstrom or a whirlpool spell
A hazard that pulls things towards a centre
Pair with Foam Burst at the centre and Bubbles rising outside it

presets.name: Will-o-Wisp
presets.summary: A single flame mote circling a point, for spirits and roaming lights.
useCases: Wisps, spirits and guiding lights
A magic orb, a lantern with no lamp or a floating ember
A marker a player follows through a dark level

presets.name: Wind Gust
presets.summary: Crescents of air that curl outward and fade, for gusts and slashes.
useCases: Wind and air element hits
Dash trails, sword slashes and knockback puffs
Retint to sandy beige and lower the speed for a dust devil

presets.name: Wind Trail
presets.summary: Curls of air that peel off a projectile and fade behind it.
useCases: Arrows, darts and fast melee projectiles
Wind-element bolts and dash trails
A gust that curves: rotate the projectile and the trail curves with it
